extracted.intended_audience: CIA comptroller and budget/ADP management staff; agency officials responding to OMB Circular A-76
extracted.subtask_description: A short internal CIA memorandum describing how the agency will respond to OMB Circular A-76 (government reliance on commercial services) including planned submission of the Agency's Spring ADP Plan and awaiting further OMB guidance on content/format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Express agreement with the spirit of OMB A-76 and willingness to work within precepts
rubrics_metrics.description: We might express our agreement with the spirit of the concept and willingness to work within the precepts as much as possible (in response to paragraph 3 of the attached).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The memo recommends formally stating agreement with the 'spirit' of the Circular and a general commitment to comply with its precepts when responding to OMB's paragraph 3; used as guidance for the agency's reply tone and posture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit Agency's 'Spring ADP Plan' directly to OMB examiner
rubrics_metrics.description: We plan to submit the Agency's 'Spring ADP Plan' directly to our OMB examiner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a procedural requirement/action: the agency should send its Spring ADP Plan straight to the assigned OMB examiner rather than through other channels; implies timeline and single-point submission practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Await and follow additional OMB guidance on content and format of Spring ADP Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: We look forward to additional guidance concerning the specifics (content and format) of the 'Spring ADP Plan.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The agency should not finalize or fully format the Spring ADP Plan until OMB issues further instructions about required content and format; indicates expectation of forthcoming detailed standards from OMB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognize increasing OMB scrutiny of government use of commercial services
rubrics_metrics.description: Nanette believes OMB is becoming more serious about Government ... organizations using commercial services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat OMB scrutiny of reliance on commercial services as a driving factor for agency actions: evaluate agency practices accordingly and prepare to respond or adjust to tighter oversight; this functions as contextual rationale for adopting the other actions above.
